ns2:section.sectionText: Both lecture and discussion begin on Monday, August 22, 2016. MCB 250 discussion sections will not meet the week of September 5, 2016. Examinations will be held on Wednesday evenings from 7:00-9:00 pm on September 14, October 12, and November 9, 2016. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment. This course-based tuition is assessed on and non-refundable after the 10th day of class.
